title: Replace Workflow section with Referral Program section

requirements.text: Remove the WorkflowSection component from the App.tsx composition and replace it with a new ReferralProgramSection component that displays the referral program information in Spanish

quotes: sustituye la parte de flujo de trabajo integrado con el programa de referals

acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowSection component is no longer rendered in App.tsx
ReferralProgramSection component is imported and rendered in its place
The new section appears in the correct position in the page flow

requirements.text: Create a new ReferralProgramSection component that presents the referral program with a heading 'Programa de Referencias' and explains the commission structure: 15-30% commission on the first contract obtained, 15% of the net value of the first contract collected from the referred client, payment after receiving full payment from the client, and transfer within 30 days after collection

quotes: 15-30% comision por primer contrato conseguido • 15% del valor neto del primer contrato cobrado por cliente referido. • Pago después de recibir el pago completo del cliente. Transferencia dentro de 30 días posteriores al cobro

acceptanceCriteria: Component displays 'Programa de Referencias' as the section heading
Shows commission range of 15-30% for first contract obtained
Clearly states 15% of net value from first collected contract
Explains payment occurs after receiving full client payment
Specifies transfer within 30 days after collection
All text is in Spanish with proper grammar and accent marks
Visual design is consistent with other sections (cybersecurity theme, proper spacing, typography)

requirements.text: Structure the ReferralProgramSection to highlight the commission details prominently using a card or grid layout similar to other sections, with icons or visual elements that convey partnership and financial benefits
acceptanceCriteria: Commission structure is presented in an easy-to-scan format (cards, list, or grid)
Visual hierarchy emphasizes the key benefit (15-30% commission)
Includes appropriate icons or visual elements
Layout is responsive and matches the design pattern of ServicesSection or TargetClientsSection

constraints: Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui components
Maintain the existing cybersecurity design theme with consistent color palette and typography
All content must be in Spanish with proper grammar and professional business terminology
nonGoals: Creating a functional referral tracking system or backend logic
Adding a form for referral sign-up or submission
Integrating payment processing for referral commissions
Modifying the WorkflowSection component itself (it should be removed from App.tsx, not edited)
